stanza: The Mississippi Delta
Was shining like a National guitar
I am following the river down the highway
Through the cradle of the Civil War

delta.songTitle: The Night Josh Tillman Came to Our Apt.
delta.line: Why don't you move to the Delta?
stanza: She blames her excess on my influence
But gladly hoovers all my drugs
I found her naked with her best friend in the tub
We sang "Silent Night" in three parts which was fun
'Til she said that she sounds just like Sarah Vaughan
I hate that soulful affectation white girls put on
Why don't you move to the Delta?
I obliged later on when you begged me to choke ya

delta.line: Now when she left the Delta
stanza: Now when she left the Delta
It was 1966
Come to Los Angeles
She was nine years old
And there was work to be had
Grandaddy worked at Firestone
Made enough to buy a home
Out on Wilmington Avenue
Then the jobs moved out
Grandaddy died and we lost the house
Moved into the Jordan Downs
And been here ever since
